issues.title: Mobies behind Ratchet are not rendered when using freecam
issues.author: stentines
issues.body:
Can you please fix this? Mobies are moving objects like npcs, enemies, projectiles, ships. It's a term used by insomniac. How to reproduce: Open freecam and explore the level, you will see that in some parts of the level enemies/npcs will not appear.


Thank you
